metadata.question: On August 3, 2025, were there more than 120 fires active in Saskatchewan, Canada?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to detect active fires on a specific date: August 3, 2025 - Use MODIS or VIIRS active fire products - FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) data via MODIS/VIIRS - Best option: MODIS Collection 6.1 (MCD14DL) or VIIRS 375m (VNP14IMGML) - Location: Saskatchewan, Canada (approximate bounds: 49-60°N, 101-110°W) 2. Masking strategy: - For fire detection, we want to count fire pixels, not mask them - Filter by confidence level (high/nominal confidence fires) - Use the 'FireMask' or similar band to identify active fires 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If collection is empty: C1 - If valid pixels = 0 after processing: This could be B (no fires) or C2 depending on context - Count fire detections - if count > 120: A, if 0-120: B - If calculation fails (None/NaN): C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Saskatchewan geometry (approximate bounds) const saskatchewan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-110, 49], [-110, 60], [-101, 60], [-101, 49], [-110, 49]] ]); // 2. Define date range for August 3, 2025 const targetDate = '2025-08-03'; const startDate = '2025-08-03'; const endDate = '2025-08-04'; // 3. Try MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire daily product let fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(saskatchewan); let collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS MOD14A1 Images found: ${collectionSize}`); // If MODIS fails, try VIIRS if (collectionSize === 0) { fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(saskatchewan); collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS MYD14A1 Images found: ${collectionSize}`); } // If still no data, try FIRMS VIIRS if (collectionSize === 0) { fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(saskatchewan); collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`FIRMS Images found: ${collectionSize}`); } if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No fire detection data available for August 3, 2025."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Process fire data - use FireMask band (7-9 are fire classes) const fireImage = fireCollection.first(); const fireMask = fireImage.select('FireMask').gte(7).and(fireImage.select('FireMask').lte(9)); // 5. Count fire pixels in Saskatchewan const fireStats = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: saskatchewan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const fireCount = fireStats.get('FireMask').getInfo(); if (fireCount === null || fireCount === undefined) { console.log("Fire count calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 6. Validation - check if we have valid data const totalPixels = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: saskatchewan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log(`Total pixels analyzed: ${totalPixels}`); console.log(`Active fire detections: ${fireCount}`); if (totalPixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 7. Final answer if (fireCount > 120) { console.log(`Fire count (${fireCount}) exceeds 120.`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Fire count (${fireCount}) does not exceed 120.`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
